claims.statement: The frontend layout renders SiteHeader with the cached site counts, Dofus menu items, checklist menu items, standalone pages, social links, navigation sections and featured eggs, and SiteFooter with the legal links, site settings and navigation sections, around every page, and puts the top anchor on the body.

nav.ts defines five sections, with Misiones linking to /metalogros, Dofus linking to /guias-dofus, Checklists linking to /checklists, and pages the app does not have yet linking to the legacy Squarespace site through legacyHref, with the same slug except where Torre's page is named differently.

SiteHeader renders the lockup, a dropdown panel for each section that has pages, the Ko-fi button, the search button, the theme picker, the mode switch and the phone menu below 1200px on the server, and MenuPanelPreview shows a static open panel for the catalog.
SiteFooter has Torre, Explorar and Comunidad columns plus a legal band, each link appearing once, without a live state yet, with its texts, name and social links from the site settings.

HeaderIsland opens and closes the menu panels and the phone sheet, opens the search with Ctrl K or slash, and loads the search engine, its results and the guide index with import() the first time the search opens, never on page load.
GET /api/search/guides returns every published guide as a title, slug, achievement and level tuple sorted by title, read as an anonymous visitor with overrideAccess false and draft false.

The search index endpoint reads with req.payload so the index never takes the requester's permissions, caches it under the content tags, and sends Cache-Control public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=3600.
The search index endpoint returns plain JSON and leaves compression to Next, which adds Vary: Accept-Encoding.

Search ranking requires every word, ranks names starting with the query first, then word-start matches, then contained matches, breaks ties by length then alphabetically, and shows all up to 50 matches or the best 20 beyond that.
queryKind requires at least two letters or digits before searching, and search-query.ts is small on purpose because it ships in the islands' initial JavaScript.
loadEntries fetches the search index once per page, sharing the promise between the home search and the header dialog, and forgets a failed request so the next use retries.
highlight returns the name in parts with each occurrence of each word marked, compared without accents or case, for rendering as text and mark rather than innerHTML.
The unit test asserts the search arrives by import() when the dialog opens and that the island and the lazy chunk share no string or icon modules.
The guide search index integration test checks that only published guides appear, with their published version and the level Torre corrected or wrote, each once and sorted by title.

The header E2E spec covers dropdowns, keyboard navigation, Ctrl K search, the index requested on open, loading and error states, focus return, the flat opaque bar from the top, the current section's color, axe in both modes, the phone menu, overflow down to 320px and Volver arriba.

No quest or achievement link in the header leaves the app: the Misiones panel has the search button and a single Ver todo link to /metalogros, repeated in the phone sheet, and its section tile has no separate all link.

The search index also carries the achievement pages and metalogros the metalogros index opens, built by achievementSearchRows from that index view, so an achievement in preparation is not searchable, and content rows for Dofus guides, checklists and standalone pages; these lists are optional so an older cached response still works.
The search index is cached under the guide-pages, achievement-pages, dofus-guides, checklists and pages tags, so saves in those collections expire it.

siteEntries turns the index into quest entries linking to their guide with level and achievement, achievement entries linking to their page with metalogro and quest count, metalogro entries linking to /metalogros#anchor with their counts, and content entries for Dofus guides, checklists and pages, throwing on a malformed row.

searchSite ranks quests, achievements and metalogros each in its own group and orders groups by best match, with quests, then achievements, metalogros and the menu groups on a tie; heroResults does the same without the menu sections but with the Dofus guides, checklists and pages of the index.
The search status line counts quests, achievements, metalogros and menu matches, and when any group passes 50 it says más de 50 for that group and ends the found part with sigue escribiendo.

Clases and Mazmorras start with soon set in the navigation defaults, which renders them in the header nav as an aria-disabled span with the Próximamente tag and no panel, as a phone sheet tile that does not fold, and as text with the tag in the footer's Explorar column.

The Dofus panel lists the Dofus of the dofus-guides collection in its order; a Dofus without a published guide renders as an aria-disabled egg-soon element with no link and an en preparación note for screen readers.

The header's menu search index includes only the visible navigation sections without soon, the Dofus of the collection that have a link, the checklists that have a link and the standalone pages that open here, so a Próximamente section, the classes and dungeons, Dofus in preparation, checklists without a link and pages that only link to Squarespace are never found.
HeaderIsland toggles a panel only from a button.np and folds a phone tile only from a button.stile__b, so the Próximamente items that share those classes open nothing.
The Dofus panel ends with Ver todas las guías de Dofus, linking to the app's /guias-dofus index, and the phone sheet repeats it.

The layout passes the Dofus list from loadDofusNav, the checklists from loadChecklistNav and the standalone pages from loadPageNav to SiteHeader, which uses them for the Dofus panel, the phone sheet and searchIndex.
Menu panels enter with @starting-style and leave in 150 ms with display held by allow-discrete so the exit is visible, and have no transition under reduced motion.

loadChecklists is one unstable_cache read of the checklists collection under the checklists tag, and loadChecklistNav maps it to menu items that link a published checklist to its page and an in-preparation one to its legacy page when it has one.

The Dofus panel and the phone sheet list the collection's checklists keyed by slug with a Ver todas las checklists link to the checklists index, mark an in-preparation checklist for screen readers or render it as an aria-disabled span without a link, and omit the block when there are no checklists.

The footer face's shadow is a radial gradient behind the image rather than a CSS filter, because with a filter Chrome counted the lazy footer image as a larger box and it became the phone LCP on /checklists.

legalLinks links each legal page to its published page in the pages collection, or to its Squarespace page otherwise, and socialLinks builds Torre's links from the site settings with the built-in ones as fallback.

The integration test of the search content rows checks a published Dofus guide with Torre's corrected egg, no Dofus guide in preparation, checklists as the menu links them, and only published standalone pages that open here.

The header nav, phone sheet, footer Explorar column and search follow the Navegación sections: Torre's order and names, hidden sections left out, the section phrase under the name or the section's figure when empty, and a section without Próximamente and without a panel rendered as a plain link; the phone sheet opens the first section that has a panel.

The menu's class and dungeon lists come from classLinks and dungeonLinks over the published class and dungeon pages, falling back to the built-in CLASSES and DUNGEONS lists, and the header counts them in the Clases and Mazmorras phrases.

The header is a flat, sticky bar in --color-bar with a line under it, always opaque, and a page marks its section with pageSection on its main so the header paints that section's nav button in its color.
The Ko-fi header button is hidden on phones, shows its text from 768 to 1199px, hides from 1200 to 1279px, shows only the cup from 1280 to 1583px and its text again from 1584px.

The floating Ko-fi sits in a zero-height sticky dock before the footer that is a scroll-state container, so the button fades out once the dock stops being stuck at the bottom, with no JavaScript; it also hides while the home search results are open and over a desktop checklist.
HeaderIsland loads the theme picker's logic with import() on first use of its button or arrow keys, and on mount syncs the picker when its data-current differs from the html theme.

From 1200 to 1279px each nav item has 0.25rem side padding and from 1440 to 1663px the search pill hides its Ctrl K hint and can shrink to 11rem, leaving slack for Linux's wider text before the right gutter.

/buscar is a server-rendered results page for the home search without JavaScript: it takes the first q trimmed and capped at 100 characters, reads the cached search index only when there is something to search, ranks with the home search's heroResults, and is noindex but follow.
SearchPage renders a form that posts back to /buscar with the text in a field whose id differs from the header dialog's, the status in a role=status line, and the results with the dialog's rows.

isExternalHref counts an http or https URL as another site when its host is not Torre's domain or a subdomain of it, and such links open in a new tab with noopener and a hidden note in the header, footer and home sections.
